# Guidance template

The `security-guidance` plugin adds `.claude/claude-security-guidance.md` to the prompt of each diff review. It joins the user file (`~/.claude/claude-security-guidance.md`), this project file, and `.claude/claude-security-guidance.local.md`, in that order. The total budget is 8 KB, and the text past it is cut. So the generated section must be **4 KB or less**.

Write the section between these markers. Keep all text outside the markers as it is. When the file has no markers, append the section to the end of the file.

```markdown
<!-- security-test:begin — generated by /security-test from docs/security/requirements.md; edit that file, not this section -->
## Project security requirements

Data: <the sensitive data classes, one line>.
Roles: <role> (<one-line power>), ….
Tenancy: <the tenant boundary, and where lookups are scoped>.

Review each diff for these, highest risk first:

1. <top risk as a review rule, e.g. "Every query on Invoice is scoped to request.org (app/billing/queries.py).">
2. …

Auth rules:

- <rule from Authentication and Sessions, e.g. "Session cookies are HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax.">

Accepted risks (do not flag): <one line each>.
<!-- security-test:end -->
```

After you write it, check the size:

```bash
sed -n '/<!-- security-test:begin/,/<!-- security-test:end -->/p' .claude/claude-security-guidance.md | wc -c
cat ~/.claude/claude-security-guidance.md .claude/claude-security-guidance.md .claude/claude-security-guidance.local.md 2>/dev/null | wc -c
```

The first count must be 4096 or less. When the second count is more than 8192, tell the user which file to shorten.
